title: Fix: migrating a document attachment deletes shared Tenant Media
summary: Document attachment migration no longer deletes shared Tenant Media records, preventing silent loss of content when attachments are copied to posted documents.
key_points: Adds guard to prevent deletion of Tenant Media when other attachments reference the same media row
Introduces three new unit tests verifying shared media protection and proper cleanup when attachment is the sole owner
Fixes silent skipping of copied attachments during external storage migration that left records with missing content
Protects internal Tenant Media deletion the same way external blob deletion was already protected
quote: Deleting that row on behalf of one attachment destroys the content of every attachment copied from it.
